headline: Tuan Sing to Acquire Westgate Tower in Jurong for $600M
summary: Tuan Sing Holdings has agreed to purchase the 20-storey Westgate Tower office building in Jurong for $600 million.
why: Tuan Sing is a prominent Singapore-based real estate investment and development company.

impacts.name: Commercial Real Estate
impacts.why: Large commercial transactions reflect active liquidity and valuation benchmarks in the property sector.
